moment.subject: kitten
moment.why: The kitten stops sniffing and stares straight at the camera in a sharp still pause.

bridge.idea: The frozen frame crunches like a dry treat with cracks spreading out as the kitten keeps staring, then crumbs fall away to reveal the ad underneath.
lines: He stopped sniffing to stare at you.
bridge.why: The hard stare holds the viewer while the crunching frame and the sniff-to-crunchy lines turn his pause into the treat itself.

lines: He stopped sniffing to stare at you.
